subject.title: Feature request: option to display cost estimates in a non-USD currency (e.g. GBP)

question: Should local API-rate estimates remain USD-only, follow a user-selected display currency, or follow Claude’s account-reported currency when available?
rationale: The request adds financial-display behavior and the API currency represents account billing data rather than a conversion rule for local token-price estimates; the repository vision requires sign-off for new features.

options.title: Add an explicit estimate-currency preference
options.body: Convert only local API-rate estimates using a documented rate source and timestamp, while retaining the estimate disclaimer.

options.title: Follow the Claude account currency
options.body: Use the provider-reported currency where available, but define how the app obtains and labels the exchange rate for the independent local estimate.

options.title: Keep local estimates in USD
options.body: Preserve the current API-price denomination and improve the explanatory copy so it is not mistaken for account billing.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit estimate-currency preference
recommendation.body: Convert only local API-rate estimates using a documented rate source and timestamp, while retaining the estimate disclaimer.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md assigns new-feature acceptance to explicit sign-off, and this is a cross-surface product-policy choice.
